mapper.sql: a.*, p.name_ko, CASE WHEN a.concurrent_key IS NULL THEN 'main' ELSE 'concurrent' END AS scope, a.assignment_key = due.assignment_key AS current_effective, a.assignment_key = CASE WHEN a.concurrent_key IS NULL THEN p.applied_assignment_key ELSE cp.applied_assignment_key END AND a.version = CASE WHEN a.concurrent_key IS NULL THEN p.applied_assignment_version ELSE cp.applied_assignment_version END AS applied, (a.assignment_key = due.assignment_key OR a.assignment_date > #{today}) AND NOT COALESCE(a.assignment_key = CASE WHEN a.concurrent_key IS NULL THEN p.applied_assignment_key ELSE cp.applied_assignment_key END AND a.version = CASE WHEN a.concurrent_key IS NULL THEN p.applied_assignment_version ELSE cp.applied_assignment_version END, FALSE) AS pending

FROM hrm_assignment a JOIN hrm_person p ON p.person_key = a.person_key LEFT JOIN hrm_concurrent_person cp ON cp.concurrent_key = a.concurrent_key LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.assignment_key FROM hrm_assignment d WHERE d.person_key = a.person_key AND d.concurrent_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.concurrent_key AND d.del_yn = 'N' AND d.assignment_date <= #{today} ORDER BY d.assignment_date DESC, d.assignment_order DESC, d.assignment_key DESC LIMIT 1 ) due ON TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hrm_assignment a JOIN hrm_person p ON p.person_key = a.person_key
SELECT * FROM hrm_person WHERE person_key = #{personKey} FOR UPDATE

SELECT cp.*, p.name_ko FROM hrm_concurrent_person cp JOIN hrm_person p ON p.person_key = cp.person_key WHERE cp.person_key = #{personKey} AND cp.concurrent_key = #{concurrentKey} AND cp.del_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF cp

SELECT *, CASE WHEN concurrent_key IS NULL THEN 'main' ELSE 'concurrent' END AS scope FROM hrm_assignment WHERE person_key = #{personKey} AND concurrent_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{concurrentKey,jdbcType=CHAR} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY assignment_date DESC, assignment_order DESC, assignment_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hrm_assignment (assignment_key,person_key,employee_no,concurrent_key,assignment_date,assignment_order, assignment_type_code,dept_cd,grade_code,position_code,employment_type_code,job_title_code, assignment_content,assignment_end_date,dispatch_country_code,remark,concurrent_assignment_yn, historical_reason,version,del_yn,reg_user,reg_user_ip,upd_user,upd_user_ip) VALUES (#{row.assignmentKey},#{row.personKey},#{row.employeeNo},#{row.concurrentKey},#{row.assignmentDate},#{row.assignmentOrder}, #{row.assignmentTypeCode},#{row.deptCd},#{row.gradeCode},#{row.positionCode},#{row.employmentTypeCode},#{row.jobTitleCode}, #{row.assignmentContent},#{row.assignmentEndDate},#{row.dispatchCountryCode},#{row.remark}, CASE WHEN #{row.scope} = 'main' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, #{row.historicalReason},0,'N',#{audit.userId},#{audit.ip},#{audit.userId},#{audit.ip})
mapper.update: UPDATE hrm_assignment SET employee_no=#{row.employeeNo},concurrent_key=#{row.concurrentKey}, concurrent_assignment_yn=CASE WHEN #{row.scope} = 'main' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, assignment_date=#{row.assignmentDate},assignment_order=#{row.assignmentOrder}, assignment_type_code=#{row.assignmentTypeCode},dept_cd=#{row.deptCd},grade_code=#{row.gradeCode}, position_code=#{row.positionCode},employment_type_code=#{row.employmentTypeCode},job_title_code=#{row.jobTitleCode}, assignment_content=#{row.assignmentContent},assignment_end_date=#{row.assignmentEndDate}, dispatch_country_code=#{row.dispatchCountryCode},remark=#{row.remark},historical_reason=#{row.historicalReason}, version=version+1,upd_user=#{audit.userId},upd_user_ip=#{audit.ip},upd_dtm=NOW() WHERE assignment_key=#{row.assignmentKey} AND version=#{row.version} AND del_yn='N'

UPDATE hrm_assignment SET del_yn='Y',version=version+1,historical_reason=#{reason}, upd_user=#{audit.userId},upd_user_ip=#{audit.ip},upd_dtm=NOW() WHERE assignment_key=#{key} AND version=#{version} AND del_yn='N'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hrm_org_dept WHERE dept_cd=#{deptCd} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM com_code WHERE code=#{code} AND parent_code=#{category} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_country_code WHERE country_code=#{countryCode})
SELECT code,code_name FROM com_code WHERE parent_code=#{category} AND use_yn='Y' ORDER BY sort_order,code
SELECT person_key,employee_no,name_ko,dept_cd,grade_code FROM hrm_person ORDER BY employee_no,person_key LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT cp.*,p.name_ko FROM hrm_concurrent_person cp JOIN hrm_person p ON p.person_key=cp.person_key WHERE cp.person_key=#{personKey} AND cp.del_yn='N' ORDER BY cp.concurrent_number,cp.concurrent_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hrm_concurrent_person(concurrent_key,person_key,employee_no,concurrent_number,reg_user,reg_ip,upd_user,upd_ip) SELECT #{row.concurrentKey},#{row.personKey},#{row.employeeNo},next_concurrent_number-1, #{audit.userId},CAST(#{audit.ip} AS INET),#{audit.userId},CAST(#{audit.ip} AS INET) FROM hrm_person WHERE person_key=#{row.personKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE hrm_person SET dept_cd=#{row.deptCd},grade_code=#{row.gradeCode},position_code=#{row.positionCode}, employment_type_code=#{row.employmentTypeCode},job_title_code=#{row.jobTitleCode}, service_status_code=CASE WHEN #{row.assignmentTypeCode}='105-060' THEN '101-020' ELSE '101-010' END, retire_date=CASE WHEN #{row.assignmentTypeCode}='105-060' THEN #{row.assignmentDate} ELSE NULL END, applied_assignment_key=#{row.assignmentKey},applied_assignment_version=#{row.version}, upd_user=#{audit.userId},upd_ip=CAST(#{audit.ip} AS INET),upd_dtm=NOW() WHERE person_key=#{row.personKey}

UPDATE hrm_concurrent_person SET dept_cd=#{row.deptCd},grade_code=#{row.gradeCode},position_code=#{row.positionCode}, employment_type_code=#{row.employmentTypeCode},job_title_code=#{row.jobTitleCode}, service_status_code=CASE WHEN #{row.assignmentTypeCode}='105-060' THEN '101-020' ELSE '101-010' END, retire_date=CASE WHEN #{row.assignmentTypeCode}='105-060' THEN #{row.assignmentDate} ELSE NULL END, applied_assignment_key=#{row.assignmentKey},applied_assignment_version=#{row.version}, upd_user=#{audit.userId},upd_ip=CAST(#{audit.ip} AS INET),upd_dtm=NOW() WHERE concurrent_key=#{row.concurrentKey} AND person_key=#{row.personKey}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT person_key FROM hrm_assignment WHERE del_yn='N' ORDER BY person_key
